facebook.caption:
Tourists book Phu Quoc for the beach. Locals know the sky hits different at INK 360.

Rotating rooftop bar at the InterContinental. Full 360-degree sweep of the coastline, the marina, and the South China Sea. 4.7 stars across 784 reviews and somehow still not on most itineraries.

Get here before sunset. Stay for the first hour of dark. That is the window.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
